Antelope Valley Medical Center
Response to Request to Amend Protected Health Information
March 16, 2026
Dear Mr. Hernandez,
We received your request to amend your protected health information. Your request and the record have been reviewed by the provider involved in your care. An addendum was added to your ED Note Physician Record by Provider Getskow, PA, Pauline Matar. Please see attached.
If we denied your request to change your protected health information, in whole or in part, you may submit a 'Statement of Disagreement'. You may also submit a written addendum...
